frost_shard_obelisk.d: a tall cluster of glowing pale-cyan ice crystals rising from a small mound of snow-capped dark grey stones: one tall central hexagonal crystal shard with a bright white inner glow and two shorter shards leaning out on each side, translucent light blue with white highlight streaks and a few tiny white sparkles, a little snow on the rocks at the base

fiery_forge_furnace.d: a squat round stone-brick blacksmith furnace seen flat from the front: dark grey stone bricks, a wide arched mouth glowing bright orange-yellow with flames inside, a short chimney on top with a small puff of smoke, a black iron band around the middle, and a leather and wood bellows attached to its right side

bloom_glow_mushroom.d: a cute giant glowing mushroom lamp: a thick cream stem with a few small teal leaves at its base and a big round cap in deep teal with soft glowing orange-yellow spots, a warm yellow glow under the cap, and two tiny mushrooms standing beside it

pagoda_gong.d: a large round bronze temple gong hanging by thick red ropes inside a dark purple-brown lacquered wooden frame with two posts, a curved top beam with small upturned ends and a low base; the gong has a raised gold boss in the centre, and a wooden mallet with a round head hangs beside it

vermillion_war_drum.d: a large red lacquered taiko war drum seen flat from the front, standing on a dark wooden stand with two short legs: gold studs around the rim, a gold sun-disc decoration on the drum face, two wooden drumsticks crossed on top of it

jade_rowboat.d: a small wooden rowboat seen exactly from the side, moored: honey-brown wooden planks, a pointed bow and stern curving upward, a coil of rope at the bow, one wooden oar resting across it, and a small green paper lantern hanging from a short post at the stern

frost_street_lamp.d: a tall slim black wrought-iron street lamp post seen flat from the front: a curled iron foot, a thin straight pole, a small iron scroll under the lantern, and a lantern at the top with glass panes glowing warm yellow-orange and a little cap of white snow on its roof

frost_snowman.d: a cute round snowman made of three stacked white snow balls with soft blue shading, two black coal eyes, an orange carrot nose, a red knitted scarf with fringe, two thin brown stick arms and a small dark blue top hat

frost_shard_cart.d: a small wooden two-wheeled handcart seen flat from the side: light-brown planks, two big wooden wheels with dark iron rims and two wooden handles pointing left, heaped with glowing pale-cyan crystal shards of different sizes piled on top with a dusting of snow

fiery_ember_cauldron.d: a big round black cast-iron cauldron on three short stubby legs standing over a small pile of glowing orange embers, filled with bubbling bright orange-red molten potion with a few bubbles and a wisp of steam, two iron ring handles on the sides and a wooden ladle leaning on the rim

fiery_coal_cart.d: a small black iron mining cart seen exactly from the side on two small iron wheels, riveted dark metal sides with a rust-brown band, heaped with glowing red-orange hot coals and black charcoal lumps

bloom_potion_stall.d: a cute little potion market stall built from a hollowed tree stump with a large teal mushroom-cap roof with cream spots, a wooden counter in front holding glass bottles of glowing pink, green and gold potions, a hanging bundle of herbs and a tiny blank chalkboard sign

bloom_stump_tea.d: a low wide tree-stump table with a round cut top showing growth rings, a small teapot and two tiny teacups on it, a cluster of small glowing teal mushrooms growing at its side, and a smaller stump stool next to it

pagoda_training_dummy.d: a wooden ninja training dummy: a thick upright log post with a round straw-wrapped body, a round wooden head with a purple cloth headband, two short wooden arm pegs, several steel shuriken and kunai stuck into it, on a heavy square wooden base

pagoda_bonsai.d: a bonsai tree in a rectangular dark glazed pot on a short grey stone pedestal: a twisted brown trunk with cloud-shaped canopies of deep purple and magenta leaves and a few fallen petals on the pot

vermillion_arrow_barrel.d: a wooden barrel packed with arrows - red-shafted arrows with white feather fletching sticking out - and a wooden bow stand beside it holding a long dark-wood recurve bow with a red string

vermillion_banner_pole.d: a tall wooden banner pole with a gold finial on top and a long vertical vermillion-red silk pennant hanging from a crossbar with gold tassels, the pennant carries a golden sun circle emblem, no text

jade_stone_locks.d: two stone training weights: a heavy grey stone block with a thick iron handle arch on top and a smaller stone weight beside it, a few green moss patches, and a coil of thick rope

jade_bamboo_fountain.d: a shishi-odoshi bamboo water fountain: a green bamboo spout tilting on a pivot over a small wooden frame, pouring a thin stream of water into a round grey stone basin filled with clear blue water, with a few green leaves and a smooth stone

peak_base_tent.d: a sturdy expedition tent for a mountain base camp, seen flat from the front: a triangular canvas tent in warm orange and cream with a dark open flap, a dusting of white snow on the roof and along the ground edges, wooden guy-pole tips at the peak, rope lines with small wooden pegs, and a small lantern hanging by the door

peak_supply_sled.d: a wooden supply sled seen exactly from the side: two long curved wooden runners with iron shoes, a plank deck piled with brown crates, a rolled red blanket and a coil of rope tied down with straps, a light dusting of snow on the load

peak_prayer_flags.d: a tall wooden pole with a long string of small coloured prayer flags - blue, white, red, green and yellow squares - hung in a gentle drooping line from the top of the pole to a short second stake beside it, snow piled at the foot of the pole, a small stack of stones at the base

peak_summit_shrine.d: a small summit shrine of pale blue ice crystal and grey stone: a squat stone altar with a glowing cyan crystal spire rising from it, a pair of tiny stone lanterns with warm lights on either side, a small tattered red-and-white banner on a short pole, snow caps on everything

ascend_void_altar.d: a small mysterious altar made of dark violet stone with silver star-shaped inlays: a short round pedestal with carved steps, and above it a floating glowing white-violet orb held in the air by three thin curved metal prongs, tiny sparkles around the orb

ascend_waystone.d: a tall floating cosmic waystone: a smooth dark indigo monolith with a pointed top, glowing pink-white runes carved on its front face, a thin golden ring floating around its middle, and small crystal shards drifting beneath it

abode_crystal_ball.d: a large crystal ball on an ornate golden stand: a clear glass sphere with swirling blue and pink mist inside and a few tiny stars, resting on a carved gold pedestal with three curled feet and a small star engraved on the base

abode_book_stack.d: a tall untidy stack of old magic books of different sizes and colours - deep blue, purple, teal and burgundy leather covers with gold trim and bookmarks - with a lit white candle in a small gold holder on the top and a feather quill leaning against the stack

abode_telescope.d: a brass astronomer telescope on a wooden tripod seen flat from the side: a long polished brass tube pointing up and to the right with dark blue lens caps and a small gold star emblem, three wooden tripod legs, a small leather-bound star chart rolled and tied beside it

zod_statue_aries.d: a regal polished-gold statue of a proud ram with large spiralling curled horns, head held high, seen from the front, standing on a small dark midnight-blue marble pedestal with gold trim, fine engraved celestial patterns on the gold, ruby-red and orange glowing gems set in it

zod_statue_taurus.d: a regal polished-gold statue of a powerful bull with wide horns and a broad chest, head slightly lowered, seen from the front, standing on a small dark midnight-blue marble pedestal with gold trim, fine engraved celestial patterns on the gold, amber-yellow glowing gems set in it

zod_statue_gemini.d: a regal polished-gold statue of two slim twin figures standing side by side holding hands, one holding a small star and the other a crescent moon, seen from the front, standing on a small dark midnight-blue marble pedestal with gold trim, fine engraved celestial patterns on the gold, sky-blue and white glowing gems set in it

zod_statue_cancer.d: a regal polished-gold statue of a large crab with two raised open claws and a rounded shell, seen from the front, standing on a small dark midnight-blue marble pedestal with gold trim, fine engraved celestial patterns on the gold, pearl-white and rose-pink glowing gems set in it

zod_statue_leo.d: a regal polished-gold statue of a majestic lion sitting upright with a full flowing mane, seen from the front, standing on a small dark midnight-blue marble pedestal with gold trim, fine engraved celestial patterns on the gold, amber and warm orange glowing gems set in it

zod_statue_virgo.d: a regal polished-gold statue of an elegant maiden with long flowing hair and folded feathered wings, holding a sheaf of wheat, seen from the front, standing on a small dark midnight-blue marble pedestal with gold trim, fine engraved celestial patterns on the gold, pale green and cream glowing gems set in it

zod_statue_libra.d: a regal polished-gold statue of a balanced pair of scales: a standing pillar with a crossbar and two hanging round pans, seen from the front, standing on a small dark midnight-blue marble pedestal with gold trim, fine engraved celestial patterns on the gold, white and light blue glowing gems set in it

zod_statue_scorpio.d: a regal polished-gold statue of a scorpion with open claws and a high curved stinging tail, seen from the front, standing on a small dark midnight-blue marble pedestal with gold trim, fine engraved celestial patterns on the gold, deep crimson and violet glowing gems set in it

zod_statue_sagittarius.d: a regal polished-gold statue of a centaur archer drawing a bow upward, front legs raised, seen from the front, standing on a small dark midnight-blue marble pedestal with gold trim, fine engraved celestial patterns on the gold, royal blue and gold glowing gems set in it

zod_statue_capricorn.d: a regal polished-gold statue of a sea-goat: a goat front half with curved horns and a curled fish tail, seen from the front, standing on a small dark midnight-blue marble pedestal with gold trim, fine engraved celestial patterns on the gold, teal and silver-blue glowing gems set in it

zod_statue_aquarius.d: a regal polished-gold statue of a water bearer holding a tall jar tilted forward with a thin ribbon of blue water pouring from it, seen from the front, standing on a small dark midnight-blue marble pedestal with gold trim, fine engraved celestial patterns on the gold, aquamarine and blue glowing gems set in it

zod_statue_pisces.d: a regal polished-gold statue of two fish swimming in a circle nose to tail, seen from the front, standing on a small dark midnight-blue marble pedestal with gold trim, fine engraved celestial patterns on the gold, violet and pink glowing gems set in it

zod_crest_ascend.d: an ornate golden crown ornament shaped like a spiral galaxy swirl with a crescent moon at its centre and small five-pointed stars around it, seen from the front, polished gold with fine engraving, violet and white glowing gems set in it, on a small dark midnight-blue marble pedestal with gold trim

zod_crest_stair.d: an ornate golden emblem of rising steps topped by a heavy anvil-shaped weight inside a laurel wreath, seen from the front, polished gold with fine engraving, warm amber glowing gems set in it, on a small dark midnight-blue marble pedestal with gold trim

zod_hanging_astrolabe.d: an ornate hanging celestial armillary sphere ornament seen flat from the front: a thick golden chain at the top attached to a gold crown cap, a large sphere made of three interlocking polished gold rings with fine engraved zodiac symbols, a bright glowing white-gold star in the centre, twelve small round coloured gems (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, violet and pink) set around the outer ring, a crescent moon medallion and a small sun medallion attached at its sides, and a pair of gold-and-indigo tasselled cords hanging below
